_schema.note: Producer-facing FILTER TYPE cards, named by what you HEAR (the family), not by brand. A body is a named filter type, not a corner bank. Each card = one whole 4-corner machine: HOME(M0_Q0) / AWAY(M100_Q0) / TIGHT HOME(M0_Q100) / TIGHT AWAY(M100_Q100). Tyson picks a family and listens; Claude turns the card into hidden response frames.
_schema.classes_are_internal: The E-mu-style class taxonomy (LPF/HPF/BPF/EQ_BOOST/EQ_CUT/VOWEL/PHASER/FLANGER/RESONANCE/WAH/DISTORTION/SPECIAL_FX/HYBRID) is INTERNAL inspiration only. Never shown in the shipped player. No E-mu/Morpheus/Z-plane branding product-facing.
_schema.template: Each card pulls its generation params (features/morph/Q/gates) from tools/target_templates.json by name — single source, no duplicated DSP.
_schema.reference_inspiration: Optional slug into bodies/rom. Used ONLY via the --reference path to shape the brief. Never copied, never shipped, name never carried forward.
_schema.knock_note: 808 character is KNOCK + GRIT, not low boost. The sub is the source's job; the Knock card leaves the weight alone and sculpts mid punch + upper tear. A sub-dominant body is a failure, and the Knock gate culls it (low_rolloff_min_db).
_schema.clean_room: Commercial release needs legal review. Do not copy or ship legacy coefficients, packed words, ROM data, exact curves, or preset names.

classes.LPF: low pass — keeps weight, sheds the top
classes.HPF: high pass — sheds the weight, keeps the edge
classes.BPF: band pass — one window of the spectrum, the rest gone
classes.EQ_CUT: carves chosen bands away (notches, fracture teeth)
classes.VOWEL: vowel/talkbox mouth shapes that morph between vowels
classes.PHASER: moving notches that sweep through the body
classes.FLANGER: tight comb of notches, metallic sweep
classes.RESONANCE: sharp ringing modes — metal, glass, screaming peaks
classes.WAH: one strong peak that sweeps like a mouth/pedal
classes.DISTORTION: the violence the corners drive through the chip path
classes.HYBRID: two class behaviours fused into one machine

cards.name: Vocal
cards.job: a formant mouth — vowel / talkbox character
cards.morph: changes the vowel (ah to ee to oo)
cards.q: tightens the talk — clearer speech, not a whistle

cards.name: Cavity
cards.job: a hollow boxed / tube body with one controlled mouth tone
cards.morph: changes the size of the cavity
cards.q: deepens the hollow and the mouth contrast
avoid: plain EQ bump with no hollow
neck tone becomes a single whistle

cards.name: Resonant
cards.job: sharp ringing / screaming peaks — metal, glass, scream
cards.morph: sweeps the ring / changes the shell tension
cards.q: makes it scream — harder, more selective

cards.name: Knock
cards.job: 808 destroyer — knock + grit + upper tear, the sub left alone
cards.morph: drives the tear up the body without touching the weight
avoid: all grit, no weight to ride on

cards.name: Comb
cards.job: regular moving teeth — hollow, phaser / flanger sweep
cards.morph: slides the teeth across the spectrum
avoid: mid body erased by the notches

cards.name: Cut
cards.job: carved bands / fracture — a razor that tears the high end
cards.q: selects, tightens and deepens the cuts

cards.name: Violence
cards.job: the body screams, tears, and walks the wreckage across the spectrum
cards.morph: the violence walks — features cross octaves between HOME and AWAY
